claims.text: The Commission's final-results box for Tongatapu 1 (2025 General Election) gives Tevita Fatafehi Puloka 1,343 votes (62.58%, order of election 1), Siaosi Vailahi Pohiva 758 (35.32%, order 2) and Eliesa Fifita 45 (2.10%, order 3).
claims.locator: PDF page 1, 'Final results for Tongatapu 1 - 2025 General Election'
claims.uncertainty: Personal results only; the table records no party affiliation. The document is undated and labelled revised.

claims.text: The Commission's final-results box for Tongatapu 2 (2025 General Election) gives Semisi Kioa Lafu Sika 951 votes (55.45%, order of election 1) and 'Uhilamoelangi Fasi 764 (44.55%, order 2).
claims.locator: PDF page 2, 'Final results for Tongatapu 2 - 2025 General Election'
claims.uncertainty: A poll result, not a record of seat status after the poll: the election was the subject of petition CV 49/2025 (to_sc_fasi_v_sika_20260518), whose determination is not imported, and no seat holding at the cutoff is asserted. No party affiliation is recorded.
